description: Main window: core IPC, showing the window once the page has its theme, window theme (follows the Light/Dark setting), webview zoom (the Interface scale setting) + native open-folder / confirm dialogs, desktop notifications when the user turns them on, and the updater: checking GitHub Releases, downloading and installing an update, then restarting into it. All file and git access goes through our own commands, which are confined to the opened repo.
